description: Claude Code via `ollama launch`, as a bare stateless engine node — `r4t engine ollama-claude run`, one headless turn per wake with no roster or dispatcher, local model, no cloud quota; STATUS.md/LESSONS.md in the node's own root are its only memory. Requires a8s var MODEL (`a8s add ... --model=...` or `a8s vars <name> set MODEL ...`); tune it further with --permissions and --allowed-tools on the invoke lines below; `r4t engine ollama-claude check` proves the argv still parses. Turn timeout defaults to 900s; override per node with `a8s vars <name> set TIMEOUT <secs>`.
